title: Oracle Advance Engineering-Oracle Data Integrator- PLSQL- AWS-senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Consulting \- Data Engineer (AWS \& ODI) \| Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) and AWS data engineering experience to build, enhance, and modernize enterprise data platforms. The role focuses on scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud\-based data processing, data quality, and reliable delivery of analytics\-ready datasets.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and support ETL/ELT solutions using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI).
* Build and maintain AWS data pipelines using services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, and related cloud services.
* Develop and optimize data transformation logic using SQL, PL/SQL, and PySpark.
* Create and maintain PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, triggers, and scripts to support data integration and processing requirements.
* Analyze and troubleshoot SQL and PL/SQL code, resolve data issues, and support basic performance improvements.
* Support data ingestion, integration, validation, reconciliation, and production deployment activities.
* Orchestrate and monitor workflows using Apache Airflow or equivalent scheduling tools.
* Contribute to data lake and lakehouse solutions, including Apache Iceberg\-based implementations where applicable.
* Investigate pipeline failures and improve performance, stability, and operational reliability.
* Collaborate with business, analytics, architecture, and engineering teams to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Follow engineering standards for documentation, code reviews, version control, testing, and release management.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), including mappings, packages, scenarios, load plans, and knowledge modules.
* Hands\-on AWS data engineering experience with S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon Redshift.
* Strong SQL skills and sound understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and ETL/ELT concepts.
* Working experience in PL/SQL development, including procedures, functions, packages, triggers, cursors, exception handling, and query troubleshooting.
* Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing frameworks.
* Experience with workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow or similar tools.
* Understanding of data quality, logging, monitoring, error handling, and performance optimization.
* Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and collaborate across distributed teams.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take\-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.
   

  

 Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K, renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K
   

  

 At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

**What We Need**
 The Data Platform Engineer is responsible for designing and evolving the core architectural foundation of 2K’s data ecosystem. While Data Engineers build pipelines and DataOps Engineers manage reliability, the Data Platform Engineer focuses on building the underlying platforms—including Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, and internal frameworks—that enable self\-service data capabilities across the organization. this role ensures high\-performance environment scalability for billions of global player events and creates seamless interoperability between complex data systems.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Platform Architecture \& Development: Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of core data platform components, including Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS S3 Data Lakes.
* Streaming Infrastructure: Manage and scale high\-throughput streaming systems using Kafka or Kinesis to support real\-time game telemetry and low\-latency analytics.
* Self\-Service Enablement: Develop "Data\-as\-a\-Service" (DaaS) features that allow Business Units and Studios to onboard data and manage access with minimal friction.
* Distributed Systems Optimization: Optimize Spark and PySpark applications for performance and cost\-efficiency across large\-scale distributed clusters.
* Security \& RBAC Architecture: Design and automate granular access control models to ensure data security and compliance with global regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
* Interoperability \& Standards: Ensure seamless data flow and interoperability between disparate platforms (utilizing technologies like Apache Iceberg) to maintain a Single Source of Truth (SSOT).
* Technical Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert for the data platform, translating complex business needs into scalable technical requirements and platform features.


**Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit**
* Architectural Depth: Demonstrates a deep understanding of how platform components interact and scale within a global data ecosystem.
* Innovation \& Efficiency: Drives the adoption of new technologies and methodologies to improve platform performance and reduce operational overhead.
* Problem Solving: Resolves complex, high\-impact technical issues related to distributed systems and data availability.
* Collaboration: Partners effectively with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Studio Leads to provide a high\-quality developer experience.
* Strategic Thinking: Anticipates future platform needs and aligns architectural decisions with long\-term business goals.


**Required Qualifications, Knowledge, And Job\-Related Skills**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience: 6\+ years of professional experience in data platform or distributed systems engineering in high\-volume environments.
* Core Technical Stack: Mastery of SQL and Python; expert knowledge of big data processing frameworks like Spark.
* Cloud Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in AWS services (S3, EKS, IAM, SNS/SQS) and extensive experience with Snowflake or Databricks.
* Orchestration: Experience building or extending workflow orchestration platforms like Apache Airflow.
* Architecture Mindset: Strong understanding of data modeling methodologies (Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault) and how they apply to modern cloud data platforms.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience handling high\-velocity telemetry from massive live\-service ecosystems (e.g., gaming or high\-volume consumer tech).
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for provisioning data stacks.
* Knowledge of data observability and cataloging tools (e.g., Monte Carlo, DataHub, or Soda).
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) in a data platform context.
* AI Infrastructure: Experience building and scaling Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus) to support Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Interoperability: Knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable secure, standardized data sharing between 2K’s data repositories and LLM applications.
* LLM Data Tooling: Familiarity with data preparation and governance for fine\-tuning Large Language Models.


**What We Offer You**
* Great Company Culture. We pride ourselves as being one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
* Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
* Work Hard, Enjoy Life. Our employees’ bond, blow\-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, our Office gaming spaces, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.
* Benefits. Benefits include, but are not limited to; Discretionary bonus, Provident fund contributions, 1\+5 medical insurance \+ top up options and access to Practo online Doctor consultation App, Employee assistance program, 3X CTC Life Assurance, 3X CTC Personal accident insurance, childcare services, 20 days holiday \+ statutory holidays,
* Perks. Gym reimbursement up to INR1150 per month, wellbeing program with the chance to earn up to $93 per annum, charitable giving program, access to learning platforms, employee discount program’s plus free games and events!


 As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.
   

  

 Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

 66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
   

  

 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
   

  

**Overview Of Role**
 As a Forward Deployment Engineer, you will work closely with Sales, Engineering, and Service Delivery teams to ensure our customers are achieving successful implementations of complex end\-to\-end deployments of frontier models. You will work with internal and external stakeholders to drive discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout. You must have a strong understanding of the go\-to\-market and sales processes. Gap identification and whitespace mapping comes naturally to you. You are a person who is always thinking about how agents can be used to do a piece or work better and faster. You’re not only brimming with innovative ideas but have the technical knowhow and tools to quickly convert those ideas into production grade solutions. Through your collaborative interactions with our teams and stakeholders, you’ll have an active role in shaping our stakeholder experience from start to finish.

title: Software Development Engineer III — Risk Tech
description:
**Our journey so far** 




 Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer\-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea: to create a modern, customer\-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.
 



  





 From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter \- and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2\.8 million\+ happy users on Jupiter
 



  





 Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head\-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No\-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/\- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.
 



  





 We've embraced cutting\-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like\-minded folks to join the crew.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Risk Tech is the engine room of Jupiter's lending business. Every rupee we disburse passes through systems this team owns: underwriting, eligibility, KYC, pre\-disbursal checks, fraud prevention, and pricing while decisioning in real time across our Loans and Cards ecosystems, within the regulatory guardrails of our banking and NBFC partners.
 



 As an SDE\-3 on this team, you won't just build features on the risk platform, you'll own the architecture of the systems that decide who gets credit, how much, and at what price. You'll set the technical direction for real\-time decisioning at scale, make the design calls that others build on, and raise the bar for reliability in a domain where a bad deploy has both a financial and a regulatory cost.This is a high\-ownership, high\-leverage role for someone who wants their engineering decisions to move the business, not just the codebase. This role will be owning larger swathes of the risk platform and setting technical direction across the team.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 • Own risk decisioning systems end\-to\-end — architect and evolve the platform combining bureau, income,fraud, and third\-party signals into real\-time underwriting and pricing decisions.
 



 • Lead the rule\-engine architecture that lets risk and policy teams configure and roll out strategies
 



 dynamically, shrinking the time from policy idea to production decision.
 



 • Design for co\-lending and multi\-lender models — build pricing and underwriting flows that support per\-entity policy, co\-lending splits, and fast partner onboarding as we scale our lending partners.
 



 • Build fraud\-prevention infrastructure — cross\-product systems (e.g. negative databases, identifier\-blocking,velocity and device signals) that protect the Loans and Cards ecosystems without adding friction for good users.
 



 • Set the standard for scale and reliability — own latency, throughput, and correctness for systems processing tens of thousands of decisions a day, where downtime and defects carry real financial and compliance risk.
 



 • Drive experimentation infrastructure for pricing and risk policies, enabling controlled rollouts and
 



 measurable yield improvements.
 



 • Make the hard architecture calls in ambiguous, cross\-team problems — data models, event\-driven contracts, service boundaries — and bring the rest of engineering along with you.
 



 • Mentor SDE\-1s and SDE\-2s, review designs and code, and raise the overall engineering bar of the team.
 



 • Partner deeply with Risk, Analytics, Product, and Compliance — translate credit policy, regulatory
 



 requirements (RBI, partner bank/NBFC guardrails), and fraud strategy into robust, auditable systems.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 • 6\+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, high\-scale systems end\-to\-end.
 



 • Strong command of Java and Spring Boot and clean, production\-grade system design on the JVM.
 



 • Deep, hands\-on PostgreSQL expertise — advanced query design and tuning, indexing strategy, execution\-plan analysis, transactions and isolation, schema design, and diagnosing performance under real production load. This is a core, non\-negotiable strength for the role.
 



 • Deep experience with event\-driven and distributed architectures — Kafka, queues/streams (SQS, SNS, EventBridge or similar), idempotency, eventual consistency.
 



 • Breadth across the wider data layer beyond PostgreSQL — NoSQL (DynamoDB) and analytical/search stores (ClickHouse, ElasticSearch) — and sound judgment on which store fits which access pattern at scale.
 



 • Advanced working experience with a public cloud (AWS preferred) and the Kubernetes ecosystem —deploying, scaling, and operating containerized services in production, not just consuming managed services.
 



 • Experience building low\-latency, high\-reliability real\-time systems — caching (Redis/ElastiCache) and a strong instinct for failure modes under load.
 



 • Hands\-on with a monitoring and alerting stack — Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting/on\-call systems — with the instinct to instrument systems so problems surface before users feel them.
 



 • Demonstrated technical leadership — you've owned architecture for a significant system, influenced peers,and driven decisions across teams, not just within your own scope.
 



 • Comfort operating in ambiguity — you can take a fuzzy business problem and turn it into a clear technical plan.
 



  





**Strong plus** 




 • Scala preferred, but not required — strong functional\-programming fundamentals in a modern JVM language are what matter most. Solid Kotlin, or idiomatic Java 17\+/21 (records, sealed types, pattern matching, streams), is a strong signal you'll pick up our Scala quickly.
 



 • Experience in fintech, lending, or risk/underwriting systems — bureau data, FOIR/eligibility logic, KYC, pre\-disbursal checks, or credit pricing.
 



 • Familiarity with co\-lending / multi\-lender architectures and partner integrations.
 



 • Exposure to fraud prevention systems and signals.
 



 • Rule\-engine or policy\-configuration platforms.
 



 • Delivery tooling: Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Spinnaker), and workflow orchestration (Airflow).
 



  





**What sets an SDE\-3 apart here — and the path to SDE\-4** 




 We hire SDE\-3s for judgment and leverage, not just throughput. At this level we expect you to:
 



 • Own outcomes, not tickets — you're accountable for whether a system works in production and moves the business, end\-to\-end.
 



 • Design what others build on — your architecture decisions define the constraints and interfaces for the rest of the team.
 



 • Reduce ambiguity for everyone else — you turn unclear, cross\-functional problems into clear technical direction.
 



 • Multiply the team — through mentorship, design review, and the standards you set and defend.
 



 • Balance speed with rigor — in a regulated, money\-moving domain, you know when to move fast and when correctness and auditability come first.
 



  





 The path for risk tech person is about widening that scope: from owning a system to owning a domain, from influencing your team to setting technical direction across Risk Tech, and from solving hard problems to shaping which problems we take on. We want someone who's ready to grow into that.
 



  





**Why Risk Tech at Jupiter** 




 You'll work at the intersection of engineering, credit risk, fraud, and regulation—where the problems are genuinely hard, and the impact is measurable in disbursals, approval rates, loss rates, and yield. The systems you build directly shape Jupiter's lending business, and you'll have the ownership to build them right

title: Infrastructure Engineer Specialist - WAF & DevSecOps Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 The Core Platforms \& Services team is responsible for the development and operations of critical cloud infrastructure and platform services, in support of Motorola Solutions' public and hybrid cloud\-based Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions for public safety customers. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS \& GCP to build at scale.
   

  

**Job Description**
**We are seeking a highly specialized
 **Infrastructure Engineer Specialist** 
 to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on
 **WAF configuration management** 
 and building robust
 **DevSecOps automation frameworks** 
 . This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between infrastructure stability and automated security policy enforcement across our hybrid cloud environments.**
 Basic Requirements
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* WAF Configuration \& Lifecycle Management
* Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high\-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives.
* Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments.
* Optimization \& Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
* DevSecOps Automation Frameworks
* Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle.
* Security Observability: Configure SIEM forwarding and alerts for WAF and Network logs. You are responsible for detecting anomalies (like data exfiltration attempts or unusual traffic spikes), ensuring actionable intelligence is derived from system logs.
* Pipeline Security Integration: Orchestrate the integration of automated security gates (SAST/SCA/Container Scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure that "Security as Code" is not just a concept, but an automated reality for all infrastructure deployments.
* Policy as Code (PaC): Develop and manage automated policy engines (e.g., OPA, Sentinel) to programmatically reject non\-compliant infrastructure changes before they reach production


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years in Infrastructure Engineering or DevSecOps, with a significant track record in high\-traffic environments.
* Primary Tech Stack: Extensive experience in WAF configuration management (e.g., F5, Signal Sciences, CloudFront WAF) and Nginx/Kubernetes Ingress Controllers.
* Automation Expertise: Strong proficiency in building DevSecOps automation frameworks. Expert\-level skill in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (Python or Go).
* Security Mindset: Deep understanding of automated threat mitigation, policy\-as\-code principles, and cloud\-native security orchestration.
* Hybrid Expertise: Proven ability to manage and automate security policies across complex hybrid or multi\-cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Proficiency in developing custom WAF rules (iRules, ModSecurity).
* Experience with GitOps workflows for infrastructure security.
* Certifications: Certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) or advanced security automation credentials.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.

title: Principle Software Dev Engineer
description:

 As Principal Software Development Engineering at Tesco, I am responsible for driving the technical strategy and design of Identity and Access Management solutions, which underpins the security and the overall defence capability of Tesco. This includes technology leadership for a team of Developers and System Engineers, covering software and system development of IAM technologies, systems and tools related to identity lifecycle, identity \& Access governance, privileged access management, and overall access management.
 



 I work in an agile manner, responding to the changing threat landscape, and working closely with Product Management and Identity Security Controls teams to ensure that what we are designing and developing is optimal in terms of scalability, availability, operability, cost and usability.
 



 I am seasoned Architect and have great understanding and knowledge of Cyber Security practices, and dynamic professional, will efficiently collaborating with other stakeholders like Workplace and System Infra, Network and Cloud Platform teams.
 



  





 In this job, I am accountable for:
 



 Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:
 


* System Performance and Scale
* Technical barrier to execution
* Adoption of latest technologies
* Help product in proof of concepts and technologies evaluation
* Upskilling and mentoring the team members



  





 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Software Development Engineer to technically lead our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team and serve as a leader with vision in this space. The ideal candidate will have an understanding of Product Development, Infrastructure and IAM technologies, strong leadership skills, and a consistent record of implementing secure and scalable IAM solutions. * Spearhead a highly skilled IAM engineering team, providing mentorship and guidance to ensure high performance and top notch development team and systems.

-

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

title: Principal Engineer  (Warehouse Engineering)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
 Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
   

  

 What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
   

  

**OUR CULTURE**
 Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
   

  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


 If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
**Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering**
 We’re looking for a
 **Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering** 
 to define the technical vision and architecture for Quince’s warehouse technology ecosystem. You will build the platforms that power inventory movement, fulfillment execution, warehouse operations, and returns across a rapidly scaling supply chain network.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the architecture of Quince’s warehouse integration platform, proprietary Warehouse Management System (WMS), and returns platform. You will solve complex problems across warehouse operations, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment while establishing scalable technical foundations for the future.
   

  

 This role requires a strong combination of distributed systems expertise, operational platform experience, and technical leadership. You will influence architecture across multiple engineering teams, mentor senior engineers, partner with business and operations leaders, and help shape how Quince builds technology for a highly complex and rapidly evolving supply chain.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Warehouse Integration Platform**
* Architect and build a standardized integration platform connecting Quince with third\-party warehouse operators and WMS platforms.
* Define integration contracts, APIs, data models, and engineering standards that minimize bespoke development for new warehouse partners.
* Build scalable mechanisms for monitoring, reconciliation, error handling, and operational visibility across warehouse integrations.
* Establish platform capabilities that simplify warehouse onboarding and improve reliability across the warehouse network.


**Warehouse Management System**
* Define the architecture and technical strategy for Quince’s proprietary Warehouse Management System.
* Build systems supporting inbound, outbound, inventory, fulfillment, and warehouse execution workflows.
* Design the platform to support both Quince\-operated facilities and third\-party warehouse operators.
* Establish scalable multi\-tenant architecture, including data isolation, configuration management, access controls, and extensibility.
* Define architectural patterns that allow the WMS to evolve into a scalable platform for external warehouse operators.


**Returns \& Reverse Logistics**
* Drive the architecture and evolution of Quince’s end\-to\-end returns platform.
* Design systems supporting return intake, inventory reconciliation, restocking, refurbishment, replenishment, and disposition.
* Build operational capabilities that provide visibility into reverse logistics workflows and enable efficient throughput.
* Ensure returns systems meet high standards for reliability, scalability, observability, and data integrity.


**AI\-Native Engineering**
* Drive the adoption of AI\-native engineering practices across warehouse technology.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI to exception management, warehouse operations, workflow automation, and operational decision\-making.
* Partner with Data Science and Operations Research teams to productionize AI and optimization models within warehouse systems.
* Establish reliable architecture patterns for integrating AI capabilities into operational workflows while maintaining correctness and reliability.


**Technical Leadership**
* Define the long\-term technical vision, architecture principles, and roadmap for warehouse engineering.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction across warehouse, logistics, supply chain, and platform teams.
* Establish engineering standards around scalability, reliability, observability, data integrity, and operational excellence.
* Identify architectural risks, technical debt, and systemic opportunities across warehouse technology.
* Make high\-impact technical decisions while balancing immediate business needs with long\-term platform scalability.


**Organizational Impact**
* Mentor senior and staff engineers and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization.
* Partner closely with warehouse operations, logistics, product, and business stakeholders to translate operational challenges into scalable technical solutions.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple teams and domains without relying solely on organizational authority.
* Contribute to hiring, talent development, and building a high\-performing engineering organization.
* Represent warehouse engineering in broader technical and organizational initiatives.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience building large\-scale operational, supply chain, logistics, warehouse, or similar systems.
* Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems and event\-driven architectures in production.
* Deep expertise in designing highly reliable systems where data integrity, consistency, and operational correctness are critical.
* Experience designing integration platforms and replacing bespoke integrations with standardized, scalable frameworks.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tenant architecture, data isolation, API design, configuration management, and platform extensibility.
* Experience setting technical direction across multiple engineering teams or business domains.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, fulfillment workflows, and operational system design.
* Experience balancing scalability, performance, reliability, observability, and operational complexity.
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to influence senior engineering and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and drive engineering excellence across teams.
* Experience working with AI\-enabled development workflows and/or integrating AI capabilities into production systems.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant ambiguity and ownership.


**Preferred:**

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack built for the age of reasoning. NeuralMesh by WEKA sets the standard for agentic AI data infrastructure with a cloud and AI\-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute\-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.
   

  

 WEKA is a pre\-IPO, growth\-stage company on a hyper\-growth trajectory. We’ve raised $375M in capital with dozens of world\-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world’s largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will utilize your strong technical competencies and customer management skills to provide a high level of personalized, proactive, and reactive enterprise\-class solutions and services to our customers. Our TAM team is responsible for managing and maintaining relationships with our customers, ensuring their technical needs are met, and helping them to fully leverage WEKA’s products and solutions.
   

  

 The Technical Account Manager (TAM) role is critical to WEKA’s Premium Services offerings in furthering the WEKA customer relationship and ensuring that our customers achieve the greatest value from their WEKA solution. Working closely and collaboratively within our customers’ organizations, the TAM will understand the customer's business requirements, mission, objectives, technical needs, systems and solutions, environment, and service history. This individual interacts from Staff to Executive level teams and needs to be an excellent written and verbal communicator to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

**As a Technical Account Manager, You'll**
* Provide proactive technical and operational guidance within the framework of their WEKA environment to ensure customers achieving the best possible value from WEKA.
* Establish customer cadence and proactive engagement to align their needs including, but not limited to technical and business reviews, upgrade/release planning, and expansions, and related documentation.
* Identify and address customers' critical technical issues and non\-technical issues, and coordinate necessary technical activities. Coordination of technical activities may include troubleshooting and solving escalated customer issues directly with the appropriate engineering teams within WEKA and 3rd party vendors for multi\-vendor issues when applicable.
* Monitor customer open cases during business hours.
* Monitor customer systems, utilizing auto supports and User Console to identify potential problems and trends and subsequently make the necessary recommendations to resolve them to ensure optimal performance of these systems.
* Track and maintain user configurations and environments.
* Ensure that all recommended Best Practices are adhered to for maximizing product optimization and uptime.
* Notify customers of new product features, field/product alert analysis, and recommendations.
* Help educate the customer on the various tools on the support site and help them understand their WEKA products better.
* Manage special projects assigned by management to meet customer and cross\-functional team needs.
* Build and maintain a close working relationship with both technical staff and Sr. Leadership from the customer team, in addition to building strong collaborative relationships with internal WEKA teams such as Sales, Sales Engineering, Technical Services, Professional Services, and Engineering
* You will build a holistic view of the customer and proactively identify areas where value can be maximized, increasing the footprint of products in the customer's environment over time, thereby enhancing customer retention and reference ability.


**Requirements**
* 10\+ Years experience as a Technical Account Manager (TAM) or similar customer facing role.
* Experience working with customers to identify and resolve critical technical and operational challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work within a Global cross\-functional team environment.
* In\-depth technical knowledge in three or more of the following areas is essential:
* Networking ETH/IB
* UNIX/Linux
* Storage Technologies
* Cloud Technology \- Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Backup and Recovery
* AI/ML
* Strong aptitude for learning new technologies and understanding how to utilize them in a customer facing environment.
* Ability to follow standard engineering principles and practices.
* Creative approach to problem solving.
* Ability to travel to the customers' domestic sites and other global sites as necessary.
* 24x7 availability for after\-hours on\-call support for critical issues.


**The WEKA Way**
**We are Accountable:** 
 We take full ownership, always–even when things don’t go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility \& ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
   

  

**We are Brave:** 
 We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
   

  

**We are Collaborative:** 
 True collaboration isn’t only about working together. It’s about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team\-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other and conduct positive conflict resolution. We are being transparent about our goals and results. And together, we’re unstoppable.
   

  

**We are Customer Centric:** 
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize the success of our customers, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.
   

  

 Concerned that you don’t meet every qualification above?
   

  

 Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every qualification specified. At WEKA, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned that your past work experience doesn’t match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA.
   

  

 WEKA is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. title: Lead I - Software Engineering
description:
**Role Description**
 Job Description\- Senior Front\-End \& API Developer (T3\)
   

  

* Senior Full Stack Java Front End developer Github Copilot \+ Python expertise is mandatory .We are seeking a Senior Front\-End \& API Developer with strong expertise in modern web application development and practical backend API engineering. This role will design and build responsive user experiences, reusable components, integration APIs, and lightweight orchestration services that connect enterprise systems, execute approved pipelines and automation tasks, integrate AI agents, and present data from multiple sources. The role requires hands\-on engineering, secure design, architectural thinking, and close collaboration with product, backend, platform, and security teams. Key Responsibilities: Front\-End Software Development
* Design, develop, test, and maintain secure, responsive, and modular web applications using modern JavaScript and TypeScript frameworks.
* Build reusable components, shared user\-interface patterns, workflow\-driven forms, dashboards, status views, and task\-execution experiences.
* Translate business and operational requirements into intuitive user journeys with clear validation, progress, error, approval, and recovery states.
* Implement accessibility, responsive design, and cross\-browser compatibility in line with enterprise standards.
* Optimize client\-side performance using effective state management, caching, code splitting, telemetry, and continuous performance measurement. API Development \& Enterprise Integration
* Design and build secure RESTful APIs and backend\-for\-frontend services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* Create controlled API wrappers and orchestration endpoints that invoke approved CI/CD pipelines, automation jobs, runbooks, and long\-running tasks.
* Integrate web applications with enterprise data sources, cloud services, identity platforms, ticketing systems, automation tools, and internal APIs.
* Implement asynchronous execution patterns, callbacks, polling, webhooks, and real\-time status updates for long\-running processes.
* Define and maintain OpenAPI specifications, versioning, validation, error contracts, idempotency behavior, and integration documentation.
* Collaborate with backend engineers on service boundaries, API contracts, data models, security controls, and integration patterns. AI, Generative AI \& Agent Integration
* Integrate enterprise\-approved AI agents and copilots into web applications, guided workflows, decision\-support capabilities, and task\-execution experiences.
* Build secure interfaces and API adapters for agent tool calling, streamed responses, citations, user feedback, escalation, and human approval checkpoints.
* Apply permission\-aware context, data protection, prompt\-injection defenses, and user confirmation before impactful AI\-assisted actions.
* Instrument AI interactions for quality evaluation, latency, cost, traceability, and user feedback without exposing confidential data. Security, Quality \& Reliability
* Implement enterprise authentication and authorization using SSO, OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, role\-based access control, and permission\-aware experiences.
* Protect web applications and APIs against cross\-site scripting, request forgery, injection, insecure dependencies, and secrets exposure.
* Build unit, component, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end automated tests with meaningful quality gates.
* Implement structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, client telemetry, and actionable error handling across browser and API components.
* Participate in code reviews, threat modeling, design reviews, production support, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. DevOps \& Agile Delivery
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for web applications and APIs using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tooling.
* Package and deploy solutions using cloud\-native services, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code in collaboration with platform engineers.
* Break requirements into user stories and technical tasks with clear acceptance criteria, estimates, test coverage, and operational readiness expectations.
* Actively participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement with cross\-functional teams. Required Technical Skills \& Tools: Front\-End Engineering
* Advanced proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with strong experience in React; experience with Next.js, Angular, or an equivalent framework is valuable.
* Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, routing, form handling, data visualization, responsive design, and design systems.
* Experience with accessible web development, preferably aligned with WCAG 2\.1 AA or later guidance.
* Hands\-on experience with front\-end testing tools such as Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Working knowledge of browser performance profiling, web security, and client\-side observability. API \& Integration Engineering
* Strong hands\-on experience with Python and an API framework such as FastAPI, Django REST Framework, or Flask.
* Strong knowledge of REST, JSON, OpenAPI, authentication, authorization, pagination, rate limiting, caching, API gateways, and secure API design.
* Experience integrating asynchronous and event\-driven services using queues, events, webhooks, background workers, or serverless functions.
* Experience consuming, validating, and normalizing data from multiple APIs and presenting stable contracts to web applications. Cloud, AI \& Engineering Platforms
* Hands\-on development experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS services for application hosting, API management, serverless execution, messaging, identity, monitoring, and secrets management.
* Experience integrating LLM\- or agent\-based services through secure APIs, tool/function calling, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) is preferred.
* Working knowledge of containers, Git, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, dependency management, and software supply\-chain security.
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot for development, refactoring, testing, and documentation, with rigorous review of generated code. Relationships and engagement: Builds strong engagement with internal teams and stakeholders by leading technical discussions, clarifying requirements and dependencies, managing incidents and escalations, and driving problem resolution. Actively contributes to knowledge sharing, lessons learned, engineering standards, and continuous improvement through stakeholder feedback. Job Qualifications \& Experience Education:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered. Experience
* More than 05 years of software development experience, including substantial delivery of modern enterprise web applications.
* Demonstrated experience building both front\-end applications and production APIs or backend\-for\-frontend services.
* Experience delivering authenticated, role\-based workflows and integrations in a cloud\-hosted enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting production applications through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and iterative improvement.
* Experience integrating automation pipelines, AI\-enabled capabilities, or task\-execution workflows is strongly preferred. Other Knowledge, Skills, Abilities or Certifications:
* Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, AWS Developer, or an equivalent cloud developer certification will be preferred.
* Relevant secure\-development, accessibility, React/TypeScript, Python, or AI engineering certification.


**Skills**
 React, Python, GitHub Copilot

 **Data Platform Administrator**

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Anthriq is a signal processing infrastructure company. We build the full acquisition and compute stack for human\-aware technology — from custom analog front\-end IP that captures biosignals at the source, to signal\-first compute systems.
   

  

**Anthriq Silicon** 
 is our ground\-up effort to build a new compute category.
   

  

 Read more about the Anthriq Silicon Program here:
 **anthriq.com/silicon**
**About The Role**
 Anthriq’s semiconductor design company operates an on\-premise infrastructure that includes a Nutanix hyperconverged compute and VDI cluster, an EDA compute farm, NetApp storage, Fortinet networking, and a dedicated server room, alongside a Cadence Palladium emulation environment. We are seeking an IT Infrastructure Engineer to own the day\-to\-day operation, reliability, and maintenance of this infrastructure. The role covers servers, virtualization, networking, storage, backup, and server\-room operations, and works closely with the Engineering team to support the underlying host and network requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the company's complete IT infrastructure end\-to\-end.
* Administer and maintain Linux (RHEL / Rocky 9\.x) and Windows servers across the environment.
* Operate and maintain the Nutanix HCI cluster (compute, VDI, and EDA compute\-farm nodes) — provisioning, patching, monitoring, and capacity management.
* Support the Palladium host servers (OS, drivers, networking, and connectivity) in coordination with the emulation engineer.
* Manage the Fortinet switches and firewall — VLANs, routing, firewall policies, and uplink/port configuration.
* Administer NetApp / NFS storage — shares, capacity, and performance.
* Own backup and disaster\-recovery operations, including scheduling, testing, and restores.
* Handle server\-room operations — racks, PDUs, UPS, cabling, and environmental monitoring — and track power and cooling headroom as the room scales.
* Automate routine administration tasks using Bash and/or Python.
* Maintain Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and general office IT services.
* Coordinate with hardware and software vendors and support partners for incidents, warranties, and renewals.
* Maintain documentation, monitoring, and basic security hygiene (patching, access control).
* Opportunity to build the Infra team as we grow.


**Requirements**
**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure or systems and network administration. Ownership of infrastructure is preferred.
* Strong Linux administration (RHEL / Rocky) and working knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory.
* Solid networking fundamentals — VLANs, TCP/IP, and firewall/switch administration (Fortinet experience preferred).
* Hands\-on experience with virtualization / HCI (Nutanix AHV or VMware).
* Storage administration experience (NFS / NetApp or equivalent).
* Experience implementing and testing backup and disaster\-recovery solutions.
* Scripting and automation skills in Bash and/or Python.
* Understanding of server\-room and data center operations — racks, UPS, PDU, power, and cooling.
* Ability to work independently across a broad range of technologies with strong ownership


**Good to have**
* Exposure to EDA compute farms or job schedulers (LSF, Slurm), InfiniBand, and Cadence Palladium host maintenance
* Configuration management (Ansible); monitoring tools (Zabbix/Grafana/Prometheus); relevant certifications (RHCSA/RHCE, Fortinet NSE, Nutanix NCP).

title: AI Architect
description:
**AI Architect**

 Role: AI Architect (Architecture Ownership)

 Aurigo is an AI\-native capital program management platform trusted by over 300 customers managing more than $450 billion in capital programs across North America. With over 40,000 projects delivered, Aurigo helps organisations in transportation, water and utilities, healthcare, higher education, and government plan, build, and manage infrastructure with confidence. **Role Overview:**




 We are hiring an AI Architect to lead the design and evolution of enterprise\-grade AI platforms and GenAI systems at scale. This is a high\-impact, architecture\-first role focused on solving real\-world AI problems beyond POCs—owning system design, production maturity, evaluation frameworks, and governance. You will define how AI systems are built, deployed, observed, and scaled across the organization.

* Define end\-to\-end architecture for LLM\-powered platforms, copilots, and agent\-based systems

* Define and implement evaluation frameworks for RAG systems, agents, and copilots

* Architect deployment pipelines on AWS (Bedrock, OpenAI, and equivalent services)
* Design systems for scale, resilience, and high availability using microservices
* Ensure production readiness: monitoring, rollback strategies, and cost optimization



  





**5\. Technical Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Act as the AI/GenAI technical authority across engineering teams
* Mentor engineers and guide teams on best practices, trade\-offs, and design choices
* Drive AI roadmap, platform vision, and enterprise adoption strategy



  





**Required Qualifications:**



* 10–15 years of experience in software engineering, AI, or data platforms (8\+ years in AI/ML, 2–4 years in GenAI/LLM systems)
* Proven track record designing and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems at scale
* Hands\-on ownership of GenAI / LLM\-based systems in production environments

* RAG architectures (end\-to\-end: ingestion → retrieval → generation)
* LLM orchestration, prompting strategies, and system design
* Vector databases and retrieval optimization
* Agent frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
* Evaluation frameworks and metrics for AI systems
* AI observability, monitoring, and performance tuning
* Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
* Python / .Net and relevant ML/AI libraries and tooling



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience building enterprise AI platforms (not just single applications)
* Exposure to AI governance, compliance, and ethical AI frameworks
* Background spanning MLOps, platform engineering, or applied AI research
* Familiarity with fine\-tuning, RLHF, or model customization techniques
* Experience collaborating with business functions such as Sales, HR, Finance, or Operations



  





**Success Metrics** 



* Production\-grade AI systems achieving high accuracy, low latency, and controlled cost
* Well\-defined evaluation and monitoring frameworks adopted across teams
* Reusable AI platform components deployed and leveraged by multiple engineering teams
* Scalable AI architecture handling enterprise\-scale data volumes and workflows
* Measurable improvement in time\-to\-production for new AI initiatives



  





**Why This Role Stands Out** 



* True architecture ownership — take AI systems to Production not only POC work
* Opportunity to define AI engineering standards and set the technical direction for the organization
* High\-visibility role driving enterprise AI transformation journey in an organization that is recognized as one of the Top 25 AI Companies — AI is core to the product, not a side project

title: Senior Manager, Reliability Engineering & AIOps
description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
 You will join the Reliability Engineering team within Infrastructure Platform Engineering. The group keeps Lam's global infrastructure estate available and recoverable across Azure, AWS, GCP, compute, storage, network, and high\-performance computing, supporting engineering and operations teams in the US, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, India, and Korea.
   

  

**The impact you’ll make**
 As Senior Manager of Reliability Engineering \& AIOps, you lead the team that keeps critical infrastructure running and proves it is ready for the next failure. In this role, you will directly contribute to the availability of the systems Lam's engineering, manufacturing, and business teams depend on every day, and you will build the automation that makes outages rare, short, and unremarkable.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead, hire, and develop the reliability engineering team, owning on\-call health while staying technically hands\-on.
   

  

 Set the reliability strategy: define the service level objective program, publish an error\-budget policy, and drive adoption across platform and service teams.
   

  

 Build and run a follow\-the\-sun on\-call and response model across six regions, with clean handoffs and one consistent set of runbooks and severity definitions worldwide
   

  

 Own the incident management and paging platform end to end, including services, schedules, escalation policies, and routing, configured as code and tuned so alerts fire on real risk rather than noise
   

  

 Serve as incident commander on major incidents, own executive and stakeholder communications, and lead blameless postmortems with tracked follow\-up.
   

  

 Own disaster recovery strategy and execution across Azure, AWS, GCP, and core infrastructure platforms, including service\-tier recovery objectives, backup and restore validation, failover readiness, DR certification, runbook governance, and recurring exercises measured against RTO and RPO targets
   

  

 Lead capacity planning and performance engineering across Azure, AWS, GCP, compute, storage, network, and HPC platforms, using demand forecasting, utilization trends, growth modeling, and automation to prevent capacity risk and reduce manual operational work
   

  

 Define and drive AI Ops requirements for reliability engineering across Azure, AWS, and GCP, including Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and LLM\-based operational workflows for incident triage, runbook generation, knowledge retrieval, root\-cause analysis, and safe remediation recommendations.
   

  

 This is a full\-time role on a standard schedule, with participation in a global on\-call rotation.
   

  

**Who We’re Looking For**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 15 years of related experience; or a Master's degree with 12 years of experience; or equivalent experience.
   

  

 Experience leading or mentoring a reliability or operations team and setting technical direction
   

  

 Proven incident command on major outages, plus ownership of a postmortem process
   

  

 Strong background in disaster recovery planning across Azure, AWS, GCP, and core infrastructure platforms, including restore validation, failover testing, recovery\-objective definition, and corrective action tracking after DR exercises or production incidents
   

  

 Hands\-on ownership of an incident management and paging platform at scale, such as PagerDuty
   

  

 Experience with capacity planning, performance trending, utilization analysis, and infrastructure demand forecasting for globally distributed production environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and on\-premises platforms
   

  

 Track record of defining and defending service level objectives and error budgets in production
   

  

 Working depth in observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or equivalent), infrastructure as code (Terraform), and Python or Go
   

  

 Practical experience applying AI\-assisted engineering and operations tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or enterprise LLM platforms to improve troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and engineering productivity across Azure, AWS, GCP, and hybrid infrastructure, with clear guardrails for security, privacy, auditability, and production safety.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience running global, follow\-the\-sun operations across multiple regions and time zones.
* Capacity and performance engineering at multi\-region scale, including Azure, AWS, GCP, high\-performance computing, large storage estates, hybrid cloud infrastructure, and proactive capacity governance.
* Policy as code, progressive delivery, and chaos engineering in practice.
* Experience building or operating AI and agent\-assisted automation in operations, with a clear view of its failure modes.
* Experience designing or operating AI Ops capabilities across Azure, AWS, GCP, and hybrid environments, including LLM\-grounded knowledge bases, agent\-assisted incident workflows, prompt and evaluation practices, and supervised automation that can recommend or propose operational changes before execution.


**Our commitment**
 We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
   

  

 Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non\-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
   

  

*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on\-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On\-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On\-site Flex’ you’ll work 3\+ days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1\-2 days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

title: Engineering Manager - CI
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Harness is seeking an exceptional Engineering Manager to lead the team building the
 **Harness Cloud platform** 
 , the infrastructure foundation powering Continuous Integration (CI) and several other Harness products. This is a unique opportunity to lead engineers building one of the industry's most scalable cloud\-native execution platforms, responsible for securely orchestrating build infrastructure across thousands of virtual machines, Kubernetes clusters, and bare\-metal systems.
   

  

 As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a highly technical team responsible for architecting, scaling, securing, and operating the cloud platform that powers millions of build executions. You'll partner closely with Product Management, SRE, Customer Success, and Principal Engineers to deliver highly available infrastructure that enables developers worldwide to build software faster, more securely, and at massive scale.
   

  

 This role is ideal for leaders who enjoy solving complex distributed systems challenges, growing high\-performing engineering teams, and remaining deeply engaged in technical architecture and execution.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Harness Cloud platform forms the foundation for Continuous Integration (CI) and several other Harness products. As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a team responsible for scaling and evolving the cloud infrastructure that powers our global software delivery platform.
   

  

**You Will**
* Lead a team to build highly scalable saas services that power Harness Cloud builds.

title: Zscalar/Zero Trust Security Architect - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Zscalar/Zero Trust
   

  

 Consultant**
 We are seeking an experienced Zscaler Architect / Senior Engineer to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions in enterprise environments. This role will help design and deliver Zero Trust access models, modernize remote access, and support migration from legacy VPN and proxy technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and supporting the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions.
* Assessing current\-state network and security architecture and designing Zero Trust access models aligned to business and security requirements.
* Planning and executing migration from legacy VPN, proxy, and remote access technologies to Zscaler platforms.
* Configuring ZIA and ZPA policies, application segmentation, connector deployment, authentication, forwarding methods, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and policy issues and supporting pilot, rollout, cutover, and post\-migration activities.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber team helps organizations build, operate, and enhance security capabilities across identity, network, cloud, and application environments. The team works with clients to modernize security architecture, enable secure access, and support enterprise transformation through scalable, business\-aligned solutions. Professionals in this practice collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology stakeholders to address complex security and connectivity challenges.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Regular India Shift Timing**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-9 years of experience in network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
* Experience implementing and migrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
* Experience configuring ZIA security policies, including URL filtering, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls.
* Experience configuring ZPA application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with identity and security platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross\-domain Identity Management (SCIM), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), or cloud access security broker (CASB) tools.
* Experience with Domain Name System (DNS), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing, firewall policies, proxy technologies, and VPN migration.
* Experience creating technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience designing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and remote access modernization programs.
* Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for experience monitoring and user troubleshooting.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Client Connector and integrating with endpoint platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs.
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA), Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP) for ZIA or ZPA, or Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).


 This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document https://resources.deloitte.com/sites/dnet\-tod\-usi/Shared Documents/Benefits/USIBenefitsBrochureforPlanG.pdf
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Engineers and oversees fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable designs; optimizes resilience mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting); and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across dependent services. Establishes KPIs and advanced telemetry; applies formal verification for complex features; and develops robust replication/synchronization strategies. Advises and leads resolution of complex production issues, sets operational readiness and SOP standards, and directs incident response and RCAs. Architects advanced security controls, drives remediation and compliance, and delivers enterprise‑level automation (IaC) and change strategies enabling safe, automated patching, updates, and rollbacks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:
   

  

 –Mentor the team in the architecture and design of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
   

  

 –Lead the identification of performance and scalability bottlenecks and recommend solutions to optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to improve performance for hyper\-scale systems.
   

  

 –Lead collaboration with stakeholders to define system scalability requirements, ensuring the defined requirements meet customer expectations.
